import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter

OUT = Path('testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_keywords.json')
capture = json.loads(OUT.read_text())
source_path = str(Path(__file__))
capture['sources'] = [s for s in capture['sources'] if s['path'] != source_path]
capture['sources'].append({'path': source_path, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()})
words = set(capture['documented_words'])
summary = {}
for context in ['schema','metric','where','group']:
    rows = [r for r in capture['observations'] if r['label'].startswith('word-') and r.get('identifier_context') == context and not r.get('quoted')]
    if not rows:
        continue
    assert len({r['identifier'] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
    assert {r['identifier'] for r in rows} == words
    summary[context] = {kind: sorted(r['identifier'] for r in rows if r['admission'] == kind) for kind in ['accepted','rejected','unresolved','unresolved_service_result']}
    summary[context]['counts'] = {kind: len(summary[context][kind]) for kind in ['accepted','rejected','unresolved','unresolved_service_result']}
    summary[context]['rejection_forms'] = dict(Counter('explicit_reserved_keyword' if 'Reserved keyword' in r['result'].get('message','') else 'parser_syntax' for r in rows if r['admission'] == 'rejected'))
    summary[context]['explicit_reserved_words'] = sorted(r['identifier'] for r in rows if 'Reserved keyword' in r['result'].get('message',''))
    summary[context]['parser_rejected_words'] = sorted(r['identifier'] for r in rows if r['admission'] == 'rejected' and 'Reserved keyword' not in r['result'].get('message',''))
assert 'schema' in summary
capture['documented_keyword_classification'] = summary
by_identifier = {}
for row in capture['observations']:
    if 'admission' not in row:
        continue
    key = (row['identifier'], row['quoted'])
    by_identifier.setdefault(key,{})[row['identifier_context']] = row['admission']
discrepancies = [{'identifier': word, 'quoted': quoted, 'admission_by_context': positions} for (word,quoted), positions in sorted(by_identifier.items()) if len(set(positions.values())) > 1]
capture['context_dependent_discrepancies'] = discrepancies
capture['cross_context_controls'] = [{'identifier': word, 'quoted': quoted, 'admission_by_context': positions} for (word,quoted), positions in sorted(by_identifier.items()) if len(positions) > 1]
quoted = [r for r in capture['observations'] if r.get('quoted')]
capture['quoted_controls'] = {'count':len(quoted), 'counts':dict(Counter(r['admission'] for r in quoted))}
classification = summary['schema']
capture['positive_data_controls'] = {}
for label in ['control-metric-unquoted-Load', 'control-metric-quoted-LIMIT', 'control-schema-quoted-Zone', 'control-where-quoted-Zone', 'control-group-quoted-Zone']:
    row = next(r for r in capture['observations'] if r['label'] == label)
    assert row['admission'] == 'accepted'
    assert any(item.get('Values') for item in row['result']['output']['MetricDataResults'])
    capture['positive_data_controls'][label] = row['result']['output']
capture['measured_semantics'] = [
    'The primary AWS reserved-keyword page contains '+str(len(words))+' unique tokens. Its FALLBACK token lacks a closing quote; whitespace/token extraction preserves it rather than pairing quotation marks.',
    'SCHEMA dimension identifiers: '+str(len(classification['accepted']))+' documented tokens accepted unquoted, '+str(len(classification['rejected']))+' rejected with native syntax errors. Full measured token sets are in documented_keyword_classification.schema.',
    'LOAD is documented reserved but accepted unquoted. The case-sensitive existing metric Load also succeeds unquoted; reserved keyword checks reject both ZONE and Zone.',
    'Quoted LIMIT returns the existing metric value 17; quoted Zone returns existing data in SCHEMA, WHERE, and GROUP BY positions. Their unquoted rejection is therefore not explained by missing metric or dimension data.',
    'Quoted rejection counterparts and quoted representative controls are classified independently from whether response values exist. Native Success establishes grammar admission; absent data is not used to infer metric or dimension existence.',
    'Rejection behavior and error wording are separate: explicit Reserved keyword errors and generic Invalid syntax parser errors both reject identifiers. END-EXEC contains a hyphen and cannot alone establish keyword reservation.',
    'No context-dependent admission discrepancies were found among the measured cross-context controls.' if not discrepancies else 'Context-dependent admission discrepancies are recorded explicitly; no single global keyword list is inferred.'
]
capture['inferences'] = [
    'For the measured documented-word universe, implement unquoted identifier admission using the measured rejected set, not the entire documentation list. Match keyword reservation case-insensitively; preserve normal identifier spelling/case for metric/dimension lookup. Quoting bypasses the measured reservation restriction. END-EXEC also fails ordinary bare-identifier lexical syntax.'
]
if set(summary) != {'schema','metric','where','group'}:
    capture['evidence_boundaries'].append('All documented words were exhaustively measured in SCHEMA dimension position. Metric-name, WHERE-key, and GROUP-BY-key positions have the enumerated cross-context controls, not an exhaustive claim for unmeasured words in those positions.')
assert not discrepancies, discrepancies
assert not classification['unresolved'] and not classification['unresolved_service_result']
assert all(r['admission'] == 'accepted' for r in quoted)
schema_quoted = {r['identifier'] for r in quoted if r['label'].startswith('word-schema-quoted-')}
assert schema_quoted == set(classification['rejected'])
assert all(r['result'].get('raw_response') is not None for r in capture['observations'])
assert all(r['operation'] in ('get-caller-identity', 'get-metric-data') for r in capture['observations'])
assert all(r['input']['StartTime'] == capture['sample_start_epoch'] and r['input']['EndTime'] == capture['sample_end_epoch'] and capture['namespace'] in r['input']['MetricDataQueries'][0]['Expression'] for r in capture['observations'] if r['operation'] == 'get-metric-data')
capture['cleanup'].append({'owned_temporary_sources': ['/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords.py', '/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords_finalize.py'], 'status':'Sources embedded in this fixture; the finalizer removes these owned temporary scripts after saving. Bytecode generation disabled for probe imports.'})
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(capture,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
for name in ['/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords.py', '/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords_finalize.py']:
    Path(name).unlink()
assert all(not Path(name).exists() for name in ['/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords.py', '/tmp/stackd_metric_insights_keywords_finalize.py'])
print(json.dumps({'documented_words':len(words), 'summary': {context: item['counts'] for context,item in summary.items()}, 'quoted_controls':capture['quoted_controls'], 'context_discrepancies':discrepancies, 'observations':len(capture['observations']), 'temporary_scripts_removed':True},indent=2))
